description_en: Modifies the information of an external traveler and their identity documents. Only the fields that are provided are updated. Fields that are not provided remain unchanged
description_zh: 该接口可以修改外部出行人信息以及证件信息,人员以及证件信息的字段都是传了就修改,不传不修改
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen external-user-update --external-user-id 0012 --real-name '张三' --real-name-en zhang/san --phone 13438009765 --email zhangsan@alibaba-inc.com --birthday 2000-01-02 --cert-request-list cert_type=0 cert_no=330101199010010213 nationality=CN cert_nation=CN cert_expired_time=2034-10-01 --x-acs-btrip-corp-token feth00jqwls --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExternalUserUpdate
